answer: Split keys buy no extra franchise. A joiner locks 1,800 POA for 20 epochs and binds it to a vine, the inbound payment path. At the settlement tide, bonds on that vine sum to one weight, capped at 1,800 POA; extra keys add no votes or reward. A missed check, copied ticket, or reused mixer hop cuts the vine to a 50 POA nadir and exiles all its keys for 16 epochs. Honest cost: 1,800 POA. 1,000 true vines need 1.8 million POA idle, vs ~180 POA. Weakness: unlinked-looking exchange wallets; merge hops that reconverge in four steps and slash them as one vine.
